transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. Um... well, I suppose my eating has just gotten all turned around lately. Some days I completely forget to eat lunch. And then other days... I just stand at the kitchen counter eating crackers and sweets. Even though nothing really tastes right anymore. So... I guess that's why I'm here.
Do you avoid eating because you are worried about gaining weight or about your body shape?
No... no, it's not that. I don't really think about my weight much at my age. It's just... I just don't have the interest, I suppose.
Are there particular tastes, textures, or smells that make you avoid or limit certain foods?
No, I don't think so. It's not about how the food feels or smells. It's just... I just don't care to eat.
Have you lost weight because you are not eating enough?

I... I don't really weigh myself. Like I said a minute ago, my eating is just all turned around. I miss lunch completely some days, but then... well, I eat all those crackers and things. So I couldn't tell you about the scale.
Have you noticed any significant unintentional weight loss recently?
No... like I just mentioned, I really wouldn't know. My clothes seem to fit the same, I suppose. I just don't keep track of it.
Has your eating pattern caused significant problems in your day-to-day life?

Well... I don't know if it's the eating, exactly. But... things have slipped. I stopped teaching my craft classes. And I guess I've missed some calls and appointments lately... family things I used to keep track of. I'm still managing in my own home, but... I just put off a lot of my normal routines. I have to rely on reminders a lot more now.
Have you been having trouble remembering recent conversations or events?
I don't think so. I mean... I might forget little things here and there, but... nothing major, really. Just normal, I suppose.
Have you had difficulty managing your finances recently?
No... not really. The bills get paid, I suppose. I haven't had any trouble with that.
Have you found it difficult to prepare meals that you used to make easily?
No... I don't think so. I can still put a meal together fine. It's... no trouble.
Has anyone close to you noticed a clear worsening in your memory or thinking?
Not that I know of. No one has... said anything to me about it.
Have you avoided activities or responsibilities because of your eating pattern?
No... I don't think so. My eating hasn't really... gotten in the way of anything. I just eat what I normally do.
Has a doctor ever told you that you have a nutritional deficiency because you are not eating enough?
No... I haven't been told anything like that. My doctors haven't mentioned it.
Have you needed to use nutritional supplements, such as meal-replacement drinks, because you are not eating enough?
No... I don't use those. I just... eat normal food.
When you eat crackers and sweets at the kitchen counter, do you feel unable to control how much you eat?
No... I don't feel like that. I can stop whenever I want. I just... have a few.
Does your eating pattern itself cause you significant distress or worry?
No... not really. I don't worry about it. It's fine.
How long has this change in your eating pattern been going on?
I'm not sure... I haven't really noticed a change. I just... eat how I eat. I don't keep track of it.
On a typical day, do you eat substantially less food than your body needs because you have little interest in eating?

I guess... that's actually what made me come in. My eating has just gotten all turned around. Some days I completely forget to eat lunch... nothing really tastes right anyway. And then other days I'm just standing at the counter with those crackers and sweets. It's just... mixed up, I suppose.
Have you avoided social meals, gatherings, or other activities because of your eating pattern?
No... I don't think so. I don't really go to gatherings much anyway... so, no. It's not because of that.
